packageRules.description: Tooling updates within a major version merge by themselves once the checks are green and the release is a week old. Major versions and runtime dependencies wait for the plugin's owner.
The same for GitHub Actions, which are pinned to commits.

A version in a skill is what an agent will tell a user to run. Updates are never merged automatically, come as one pull request per dependency for the plugin's owner, and are fix commits so the skill is released.
appbuilder-project-init pins this plugin to 2.1.0 on purpose: 2.2.0 is ESM and breaks the aio CLI. The owner moves it by hand.

customManagers.description: GitHub Actions that skills name in their text, their eval criteria and the workflow templates they hand out, as owner/repo@version. Renovate's own manager for actions reads only this repository's workflows.
npm packages that a skill runs or installs at an exact version: npx pkg@1.2.3, pnpm dlx pkg@1.2.3, npm install pkg@1.2.3.

Any other version in a skill, annotated on the line above with a comment that holds renovate: datasource=<datasource> depName=<name>, optionally followed by packageName=, versioning=, extractVersion= and registryUrl=. The version is the first one on the next line that follows a colon, an equals sign, an @, a > or a slash, so it covers YAML values, pkg@version, XML elements and URLs.
matchStrings: renovate: datasource=(?<datasource>[a-z-.]+?) depName=(?<depName>[^\s]+?)(?: packageName=(?<packageName>[^\s]+?))?(?: versioning=(?<versioning>[^\s]+?))?(?: extractVersion=(?<extractVersion>[^\s]+?))?(?: registryUrl=(?<registryUrl>[^\s]+?))?(?: -->)?[ \t]*\r?\n[^\n]*?(?:[:=][ \t]*["']?|[@>/])(?<currentValue>v?\d[^\s"'@,<>/]*)
